name: Small Covered Jar with Decoration of Three Auspicious Emblems Set against a Landscape of Towering Mountains and Rolling Waves
dimensions: H. 20 x Diam. 15 cm (7 7/8 x 5 7/8 in.) (with cover)
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；mid 16th-early 17th century, Wanli period；"Wucai" ware: porcelain with decoration painted in overglaze red, green, and yellow enamels, the bowstring-line borders painted in underglaze cobalt blue. Probably from the kilns at Jingdezhen, Jiangxi province
